batch.title: Cogs extraction: Phase A open items
batch.board: Cognitum cogs dashboard project. scripts/dashboard-board.mjs in the WeftOS repo has no project flag: the project comes from the token, so point WEFTOS_BOARD_TOKEN_FILE at the cogs board token. Items marked board=weftos belong on the WeftOS board instead.

sources.proof: WeftOS docs/plans/cogs-extraction-phase-a-proof.md (2026-10-07, releases and rollback updated 2026-10-26). Not imported: the file says not to import it.
sources.handoff: WeftOS docs/plans/cogs-extraction-phase-a-grok-handoff.md (2026-10-06). Not imported: coordinator prompt with local checkout paths.

done_in_phase_a: A0 freeze and ledgers: v0.8.3 tag frozen, path/branch/worktree/secret ledgers and the document ledger written (ledger, doc ledger).
A1 protocol boundary, Cogs side: cog-protocol client, goldens and the Cogs-owned licence backend; cargo metadata has no clawft-* crate (ledger, Protocol boundary).
A2 import: filtered WeftOS and Sensor Explorer histories merged, crates renamed to cog-*, SECURITY.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, CODEOWNERS, provenance and the platform-contracts index (ledger, Import graph).
Duplicate ADR-166 resolved: ADR-166 sound-detect, ADR-167 HLK-LD1040C, old filename redirects (ledger).
COG-104 to COG-107 successor decisions written (doc ledger).

A3 catalog: one catalog file with version and digest, guide bundles generated and drift-checked, explorer serves the canonical bytes, production Worker on that digest, Worker rollback rehearsed (ledger, proof).
Split-row successor text for the nine open WeftOS pages written 2026-10-07 (proof). Five of the Cogs pages are still stubs; see cogs-doc-split-bodies.
First signed release v0.1.2 (2026-10-26): 28 cogs at arm and arm64, CycloneDX SBOMs, SLSA v1 provenance, signed release-manifest.json, verify printed 56 verified, 0 failed (proof, Releases).
Single-tag install and file rollback on a Seed appliance with hlk-as201 (2026-10-26). Counted as a file-path proof only, not the two-signed-tag rollback (proof, Releases).

tickets.title: Decide on the Phase A proof report
tickets.outcome: The owner records yes or no on the Phase A proof report. A yes does not start Phase B.
requirements: Read the proof report's Open section against this manifest.
Record the decision and its date beside the report.
acceptance: A dated decision line exists on the proof report.
If no, the soak stays closed and both trees stay as they are.
tickets.completion: Decision line present in WeftOS docs/plans/cogs-extraction-phase-a-proof.md, section Approval.

tickets.title: Cut the second signed Cogs release (v0.1.3)
tickets.outcome: A second tagged release exists with the same evidence as v0.1.2, so a two-tag rollback can be tested.
requirements: Run scripts/release-gate.sh on the controlled signing host with the pinned key 6aae63e0...
Ship signed cog artifacts, checksums, SBOMs, provenance, a signed release manifest and verification instructions.
Do not move or re-sign v0.1.0, v0.1.1 or v0.1.2.
acceptance: After download, SHA256SUMS passes.
weft-cog-repo verify prints 0 failed.
verify-file accepts the manifest signature.
check-matrix passes for every cog under src/cogs.
tickets.completion: Tag v0.1.3 on origin with the release assets and a verify receipt.

tickets.title: Tag and sign a Cog Host release
tickets.outcome: Cog Host ARM binaries ship from a tag with signatures and provenance instead of one unsigned build.
requirements: Build weft-cog-host for armv7, aarch64 and x86_64 from a tag.
Sign and attest them with the Cogs release machinery, not the WeftOS updater key.
acceptance: Each Cog Host binary has a checksum, signature and provenance entry in a signed manifest.
verify accepts them.
tickets.completion: Signed Cog Host assets on a release tag.
refs: proof: Open (Cog Host ARM binaries remain the single unsigned build)

tickets.title: Rehearse a rollback between two signed Cogs releases and of Cog Host
tickets.outcome: Rollback from the newer signed release to the older one is proven on an appliance, for a cog and for Cog Host.
requirements: Install the newer tag, switch the consumer back to the older tag, then forward again.
Use a cog that is running, not only installed, so the proof covers a running swap.
Do the same for Cog Host.
acceptance: Hashes, signatures, licences and revocations still hold at each step.
No mutable artifact was overwritten.
Receipt records before and after hashes.
tickets.completion: Rollback receipt added to the proof report.
refs: proof: Releases (cog0 rehearsal proves the file path only) and Open

tickets.title: Placement re-places an unloaded cog instance, leaving two running
tickets.outcome: Unloading the prior instance during an upgrade keeps it unloaded.
requirements: Reproduce: place board-telemetry v0.1.2 on the aarch64 host, unload the prior instance; within about four minutes the placement lifecycle re-places it (record present, migratable: true).
acceptance: A test fails on the current code and passes after the fix.
Repeating the Ventuno rehearsal leaves exactly one instance.
tickets.completion: Fix merged in WeftOS with the failing-then-passing test; rehearsal repeated and counted.

tickets.title: Point consumers at a tagged Cogs release
tickets.outcome: Appliances, servers and Sensor Explorer run from a tagged release, not from WeftOS sources or a branch.
requirements: Deployment configuration installs Cog Host and cogs from a tag.
Sensor Explorer production runs a version built from a tag (production is still Worker 6033a9ab; v0.1.1 was never deployed).
Canary on development hardware before production services move.
acceptance: Each consumer reports the tag and catalog digest it runs.
Canary receipt recorded before the production move.
tickets.completion: Consumer ledger lists every consumer on a tag.

tickets.title: Land the daemon cog.check_run handler and consume a tagged cog-protocol
tickets.outcome: WeftOS answers Cog Host licence checks over weftos.cog.v1 from merged code and depends on a tagged protocol crate.
requirements: Merge the WeftOS feat/cog-protocol-boundary branch, including the local clippy fix that was not pushed.
Pin cog-protocol to a tag or published version, never a branch.
Run the same golden vectors in both repositories.
acceptance: WeftOS scripts/build.sh gate passes all checks after the merge (last run 21 of 23; not rerun after the clippy fix).
Golden vector tests pass in WeftOS and in this repo.
tickets.completion: Merged on the WeftOS integration branch with gate receipt.

tickets.title: Confirm registry.json is covered by a signature
tickets.outcome: A consumer can tell a tampered registry.json from the published one.
requirements: Check whether the signed release-manifest.json covers registry.json. If not, sign it or add it to the manifest.
acceptance: A negative test with an edited registry.json fails verification.
tickets.completion: Test in cog-repo and a note in the release how-to.
refs: proof: Open (registry.json is still not itself signed, written before v0.1.2)
plan: Validation gates (signed registry negative tests)

tickets.title: Move the product bodies of the split documentation pages
tickets.outcome: The Cogs pages hold the product tables, not ownership stubs.
requirements: Five Cogs pages are ownership stubs; the board tables, catalog tables, research brief and the full sensor-node spec remain on the WeftOS pages.
Import the hardware catalog pages classified as move (catalog index, module types, manufacturer pages) after a leak check.
Keep OS claims in WeftOS. Do not keep two editable bodies.
acceptance: Each split or move row in the doc ledger has its product body here.
The WeftOS page links to the successor.
Leak check of the imported pages is clean.
tickets.completion: Doc ledger rows marked done with the commit that moved each body.
refs: doc ledger: File classification, Disposition table
proof: Proven (five cogs pages are stubs)

tickets.title: Run the documentation acceptance gate in CI
tickets.outcome: CI fails on a broken link, a duplicate decision id, missing provenance or a private path.
requirements: Add link validation, decision-id uniqueness, provenance and stale-path checks to CI.
Add the public-repo leak scan (client names, private paths, tailnet addresses, secrets) to CI.
CI today runs scripts/cross-build.sh; run scripts/repo-gate.sh as well.
acceptance: A seeded broken link and a seeded duplicate ADR number each fail CI.
tickets.completion: Workflow merged and a passing run on the integration branch.
refs: plan: Documentation acceptance gate items 2-5, Validation gates
ledger: Not done (build.yml runs cross-build only)

requirements: Add successor links only. No renumbering, no deletion.
acceptance: Each of the four WeftOS ADRs names its COG successor and links to a tagged path.
tickets.completion: WeftOS docs/adr/README.md and the four ADRs updated on the WeftOS integration branch.

Test the seed round trip on local D1 before the remote apply.
